Hi Sam — great to connect. Wed 2027-06-09 at 14:00 PDT works for our team; I scheduled a 45m slot and will share the calendar invite once Marissa confirms availability.

Quick answers up front:
- Sampling window: 14 days is usually sufficient for a SIG intake, but if you expect seasonal spikes we'd ask for 30 days. Preferred formats: compressed JSONL or gzipped syslog (we can accept CloudWatch/Datadog exports if that's easier).
- Recording: we do record intake calls for internal audit notes. We're happy to record with explicit consent from AtlasAI attendees — we will obtain verbal consent on the call and stop recording if any participant objects.
- Typical artifacts: CAIQ summary, evidence checklist (we'll mark where you can replace PII before upload), a short SOC 2 status summary (not a full report unless requested), and log sampling guidance.

Two clarifying questions for your team before the call:
1) Any PII or regulated data in the sample logs we should redact (user emails, IPs, etc.)? If so, please indicate which fields you prefer us to ignore or to provide an example redaction script.
2) Do you need evidence about third-party vendors (CDN, auth provider) included in our matrix, or will you manage vendor attestations separately?

Attaching a short pre-call checklist we usually send. Marissa, can you pick this up as evidence owner and prep the CAIQ summary? Irene, please take point on logs/retention samples.

Cheers,
